statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES / orange. Tail remains elevated because the Nasdaq trend is still strong, but verified NQ has held below its session high long enough to show some mean reversion rather than uninterrupted extension.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Current evidence supports an elevated, not high, Tail state: technology leadership remains strong while the NQ pullback and lack of a fresh verified high reduce the probability of a persistent no-retracement path.
headline: Tail eases modestly as NQ consolidates below the high despite a strong technology rally
body: Delayed December NQ is 30,238.50 versus a 30,275.00 session high, leaving a measurable pullback after the earlier cash-session surge. Reuters reported the Nasdaq up 1.62% at 11:22 ET with strong chip and AI leadership, while oil and the 10-year yield were lower. The path remains directional, but fresh one-way extension is not currently verified.

lookbackSummary: Tail was low through most of Sunday and early Monday, moved to WATCH as NQ strengthened, entered the elevated band before the U.S. cash session, reached 35% after strong first-hour continuation, then eased to 32% as a measurable pullback developed.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 30% / elevated. The strong technology-led advance remains directional, but NQ is consolidating below the session high rather than extending continuously. Late-session Tail rises again only on fresh highs with shallow or failed pullbacks; otherwise the base path de-escalates after the close.

forecast.analysis: Observed NQ remains strongly higher but has stalled below the session high: delayed December NQ is 30,238.50 versus 30,275.00 high. The retracement is meaningful enough to keep Tail below high, while index and chip strength preserve elevated path risk.
drivers: NQ remains near the upper part of the session range
No fresh verified NQ extension beyond the 30,275 session high
AI and semiconductor leadership remains strong
Oil and Treasury yields are lower

forecast.analysis: If the pullback and sideways rotation persist through the next hour, Tail should ease further while the bullish regime remains intact. A renewed push to fresh highs with only shallow retracement would invalidate that de-escalation.
drivers: Continuation versus deeper rotation is the key checkpoint
Current NQ pullback argues against a no-retracement path
Cross-asset backdrop remains supportive for technology

forecast.analysis: Power hour is the main conditional re-acceleration checkpoint. Tail rises only if NQ retakes session highs and extends with shallow or failed pullbacks; broader two-way rotation would keep the path in the elevated rather than high band.
drivers: U.S. power hour begins at 19:00 UTC
Fresh session-high extension would raise path risk
Meaningful retracement would cap Tail

forecast.analysis: Into the cash close, the base case assumes some two-way auction behavior after the strong advance. Tail stays elevated if the closing auction preserves near-high structure, but falls quickly if late-session rotation broadens.
drivers: Closing-auction structure is the main checkpoint
Earlier trend remains relevant but is no longer one-way
Late rotation would reduce mean-reversion failure risk

forecast.analysis: After the cash close, Tail moves to WATCH in the base case because the continuous one-way cash-session mechanism weakens. Stress stays high while Middle East and policy headlines remain capable of moving futures.
drivers: Cash-session directional mechanism is reduced after the close
Middle East headline risk persists
Overnight futures remain sensitive to policy and oil headlines

forecast.analysis: Early evening futures are expected to normalize absent a fresh geopolitical or policy shock. Tail returns to low because no new one-way structure is assumed after the cash-session impulse.
drivers: Post-close normalization is the base case
No scheduled U.S. macro release in this hour
Geopolitical headlines remain the main discontinuity risk

forecast.analysis: The late U.S. evening base case is low Tail with residual high Stress from energy and geopolitical uncertainty. Any renewed one-way move would need fresh evidence rather than being carried forward from the cash session.
drivers: Late-session liquidity can magnify headlines
Current cash-session trend is not assumed to persist automatically
Energy-market uncertainty remains elevated

forecast.analysis: Around the UTC day change, the base case remains low Tail. The prior U.S. rally is treated as historical context, not as evidence that the next session will continue without retracement.
drivers: Overnight reset reduces direct cash-session path persistence
No scheduled Tier-1 U.S. release in this hour
Fresh futures structure would be required to raise Tail

forecast.analysis: Early Asian hours remain low Tail in the base case, with Stress still elevated because geopolitical and rates headlines can gap futures. Directional conviction is intentionally limited until fresh price structure develops.
drivers: Asian-session liquidity can amplify headline gaps
No current evidence is assumed for this future hour
Rates and energy remain background stressors

forecast.analysis: As Asian trading develops, Tail remains low unless a directional gap is followed by repeated extension and weak retracement. Stress edges higher because cross-market handoffs can expose overnight gaps.
drivers: Asian handoff is a conditional gap checkpoint
Repeated extension would be required for higher Tail
No future price path is presumed

forecast.analysis: Tail remains low near the upper edge of the band. A sustained overnight trend could move the state toward WATCH, but the forecast does not assume that such a trend will occur.
drivers: Overnight trend persistence is conditional
Cross-asset confirmation would matter if a gap develops
Mean reversion remains the base assumption

forecast.analysis: The Asian-to-European transition keeps Tail low but uncertainty elevated. A clean directional handoff with shallow pullbacks would be the main reason to raise the score from the low band.
drivers: Asian-to-European transition can alter direction
Shallow pullbacks would be a Tail amplifier if observed
No scheduled U.S. macro release in this hour

forecast.analysis: European pre-open conditions remain a low-Tail base case. Stress stays high because oil, rates and geopolitical headlines can reprice index futures even without a scheduled U.S. release.
drivers: European pre-open liquidity transition
Oil and yields remain important cross-asset drivers
Geopolitical news can create gaps

forecast.analysis: European cash trading is expected to provide a clearer cross-asset read. Tail stays low unless NQ develops persistent directional efficiency alongside semiconductors, yields and oil.
drivers: European cash open provides a new confirmation window
Cross-asset alignment would matter for Tail
Fresh NQ structure remains necessary

forecast.analysis: Tail remains low while Stress rises modestly as the U.S. session approaches. The forecast requires observed premarket extension and poor retracement quality before moving above the low band.
drivers: U.S. premarket approaches
Premarket extension alone is insufficient without path evidence
Rates and oil remain valuation inputs

forecast.analysis: The European/U.S. handoff keeps Tail low in the base case. A directional futures move becomes more informative here, but WATCH still requires persistent extension rather than a single headline jump.
drivers: European/U.S. handoff increases information flow
A single gap is not enough for WATCH
Repeated extension would change the score

forecast.analysis: Tail moves to WATCH as U.S. premarket liquidity deepens. The score reflects a more consequential checkpoint, not an assumption of one-way movement; meaningful retracement would keep risk contained.
drivers: U.S. premarket liquidity is deepening
Cash-open preparation raises path sensitivity
Retracement quality remains decisive

forecast.analysis: WATCH persists as the premarket approaches the main U.S. window. Tail would rise only if fresh directional structure aligns with semiconductors, megacaps and rates while pullbacks stay shallow.
drivers: Premarket directional structure becomes more informative
Semiconductor and megacap alignment would amplify a trend
Shallow pullbacks are required for escalation

forecast.analysis: The final European-to-U.S. handoff raises Stress and keeps Tail at WATCH. The base case remains conditional because the prior day's strong trend does not establish tomorrow's cash-open path.
drivers: European-to-U.S. handoff
Prior-day trend is context rather than future evidence
Cash-open structure remains unobserved

forecast.analysis: Approaching the U.S. morning, Tail remains WATCH and Stress is very high. The market is close enough to the cash-session decision window that gaps and cross-asset alignment matter more, but no future continuation is presumed.
drivers: U.S. morning decision window approaches
Gap size and retracement quality will matter
Cross-asset confirmation remains conditional

forecast.analysis: Before the scheduled policy remarks, Tail is at the top of WATCH while Stress rises. The events are catalysts, not proof of a persistent trend; the score would move higher only if price discovery becomes one-way.
drivers: John Williams is scheduled for 10:05 ET
Philip Jefferson is scheduled for 10:20 ET
Policy-event importance primarily raises Stress before price-path evidence

forecast.analysis: Williams and Jefferson are scheduled within this hour. Tail stays WATCH because event significance alone does not establish mean-reversion failure; persistent post-remark extension with weak retracement would be required for escalation.
drivers: John Williams scheduled at 14:05 UTC
Philip Jefferson scheduled at 14:20 UTC

forecast.analysis: After the scheduled remarks, the base case remains WATCH until actual price discovery is observed. Orderly retracement and falling volatility would lower Tail quickly; repeated extension would justify the opposite.
drivers: Post-event price discovery is conditional
Orderly retracement would de-escalate Tail
Repeated extension would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: Later in the U.S. morning, Tail is expected to ease toward the lower WATCH band if price discovery is two-way. The score remains above low because policy sensitivity and cross-asset uncertainty can persist.
drivers: Two-way price discovery would reduce Tail
Policy sensitivity can remain after scheduled remarks
Fresh NQ structure remains the primary path signal

forecastDetail.comment: Observed NQ is still strong but below the session high; the verified pullback keeps Tail elevated rather than high.
Further rotation would de-escalate Tail; a fresh high with shallow retracement would reverse that path.
Power hour is the main late-session continuation checkpoint; escalation remains conditional on fresh extension.
The cash close should distinguish persistent near-high structure from broader late-session mean reversion.
Post-close Tail falls to WATCH in the base case while geopolitical and policy headlines keep Stress high.
Early evening normalization returns Tail to low absent a new one-way futures move or discontinuity.
